checkpoints.summary: Poom's own recorded reasoning (specs/001-gold-dashboard/decisions.md, ratified 27 Nov 2026): free-source collectors run in-process on the VPS (Yahoo, FRED, CFTC, TVdataOptionOI); CME data cannot be scraped from the VPS (403 IP block + ToU), so the CME collector must be browser automation (Playwright) on GitHub Actions using his own free CME account, committing JSON snapshots to a data branch that the backend pulls. He accepted the CME ToU risk himself and decided secrets (CME_EMAIL/CME_PASSWORD) are added by him later — worker must ship dry-run/mock mode instead.

Poom authored SPEC.md verbatim (canonical design): FastAPI + SQLite backend, Nuxt 3 + TypeScript single-page mobile dashboard, TradingView Lightweight Charts + Apache ECharts, APScheduler Asia/Bangkok schedules (Sun 18:00 brief, weekdays 07:00 macro+price, 14:00 options+bias), 5-dimension weighted bias engine (30/30/20/15/5, thresholds +-60/+-20, configurable, research hypotheses not validated params) where missing/stale data reduces reliability visibly, Docker Compose deployment, LLM optional for prose only and never computes numbers.
